# arin_whois_ip (Data Source)

Look up the public Whois network containing an IPv4 or IPv6 address. Typed fields and complete XML are retained. No API key is sent. Missing records, partial results and referrals remain errors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_whois_ip" "example" {
  address      = "192.0.2.1"
  show_details = false
  show_arin    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.

### Optional

- `show_arin` (Boolean) Include ARIN's own allocation records for unallocated space. Setting false may produce a missing-record error or an empty hierarchy result. Defaults to `true`.
- `show_details` (Boolean) Ask ARIN to expand related information inline. Complete XML preserves extra records; any nested truncation is rejected. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (List of String) Ordered lines of comments.
- `customer_handle` (String) customer handle returned by ARIN.
- `end_address` (String) end address returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `ip_version` (String) ip version returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `net_blocks` (Attributes List) net blocks returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--net_blocks))
- `org_handle` (String) org handle returned by ARIN.
- `parent_handle` (String) parent handle returned by ARIN.
- `rdap_ref` (String) rdap ref returned by ARIN.
- `ref` (String) ref returned by ARIN.
- `registration_date` (String) registration date returned by ARIN.
- `start_address` (String) start address returned by ARIN.
- `update_date` (String) update date returned by ARIN.
- `whois_xml` (String) Complete Whois-RWS XML, preserving references, metadata and extensions. No links are followed.

<a id="nestedatt--net_blocks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `net_blocks`

Read-Only:

- `cidr_length` (Number) cidr length returned by ARIN.
- `description` (String) description returned by ARIN.
- `end_address` (String) end address returned by ARIN.
- `start_address` (String) start address returned by ARIN.
- `type` (String) type returned by ARIN.
